name: Direct Service Ablation Spec v1
principle: Delete separate interposition/status/bookkeeping records while preserving the substantive answer verbatim.

conditional_ablations.rule: Do not delete a tool call/result if the final answer depends on it; only suppress tool plumbing from the user-facing stream.
May remain internal; user-facing suppression does not imply runtime removal.
Prior answer remains if continuation is removed, but service completeness must be adjudicated separately.

correction_binding_rule: After an explicit correction, the next eligible user-facing behavior must omit the prohibited interposition unless needed for the task itself.
